import pygame
import sys

# Initialize Pygame
pygame.init()

# Set up some constants
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 800, 600
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
RED = (255, 0, 0)

# Set up the display
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))

class Vehicle:
    def __init__(self):
        self.speed = 0
        self.acceleration = 0.1
        self.braking = -0.1

    def update(self):
        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
            self.speed += self.acceleration
        elif keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
            self.speed += self.braking
        if self.speed > 100:
            self.speed = 100

class SpeedBoost:
    def __init__(self):
        self.threshold = 50
        self.boost = 20

    def activate(self, vehicle):
        if vehicle.speed >= self.threshold:
            vehicle.speed += self.boost

class GameMode:
    def __init__(self, name, duration):
        self.name = name
        self.duration = duration

class GameModeManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.game_modes = {
            "Time Trial": GameMode("Time Trial", 60),
            "Racing": GameMode("Racing", 30),
            "Multiplayer": GameMode("Multiplayer", 60)
        }

    def switch_mode(self, mode_name):
        for mode in self.game_modes.values():
            if mode.name == mode_name:
                return mode
        return None

class GameWindow:
    def __init__(self):
        self.screen = screen
        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    def render(self):
        self.screen.fill(WHITE)
        font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)
        text = font.render(f"Speed: {vehicle.speed}", True, RED)
        self.screen.blit(text, (10, 10))
        pygame.display.flip()

def main():
    global vehicle, speed_boost, game_mode_manager, game_window
    vehicle = Vehicle()
    speed_boost = SpeedBoost()
    game_mode_manager = GameModeManager()
    game_window = GameWindow()

    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    running = True
    current_mode = game_mode_manager.game_modes["Time Trial"]

    while running:
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key == pygame.K_SPACE:
                    speed_boost.activate(vehicle)
                elif event.key == pygame.K_TAB:
                    current_mode = game_mode_manager.switch_mode("Racing")

        vehicle.update()
        game_window.render()
        clock.tick(60)

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
